criteria_source: The fixture's runbook, plus the never-cut contract. The five steps and the conditions that gate them come from SWITCHOVER.md; that ordered instructions keep every step and the words fixing their order is rules/laconic.md's ordered-instructions item. never_cut starts empty because no archived response exists to measure a token against.
trap: Passes when all five steps appear in order and both conditions that gate the promotion survive: db-b's replay position has reached the WAL position noted on db-a, and db-a is stopped and confirmed down, before pg_ctl promote runs; and read-only mode comes off only after pgbouncer points at db-b. Fails when a step is dropped, the order is left ambiguous, either gating condition is cut, or read-only mode is lifted before the repoint.
